Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: slogan-maker
Version: 1.0.2

The slogan-maker skill is a legitimate tool for generating and evaluating marketing taglines. The primary logic in scripts/slogan.sh consists of simple text processing, heuristic scoring based on string length, and predefined templates for various industries. There is no evidence of data exfiltration, network activity, or malicious command execution.

llm.summary: The skill is internally consistent: it is an instruction-only slogan generator with a local shell script, no external installs or credential requests, and no signs of data exfiltration.

llm.guidance: This skill appears coherent and low-risk: it runs a local bash script that generates and scores slogans without contacting external services or requesting secrets. Before installing, you may: (1) review the full scripts/slogan.sh contents locally to confirm there are no hidden network calls (the provided excerpt is self-contained), (2) note the minor doc mismatch where SKILL.md references 'slogan-maker' while the repository provides scripts/slogan.sh (you may need to run it with bash scripts/slogan.sh or add a wrapper), and (3) if you want to avoid any autonomous invocation, disable the skill's autonomous use in your agent settings. If you require higher assurance, run the script in an isolated environment (container/VM) and verify no outbound network connections occur during execution.
